proposal.reason: Main functional changes are in review/merge automation: .github/scripts/review_automation.py and maintainer_approval.py add module-command handling, role-based approval rules, invitation withdrawal/reinvite behavior, and gate refresh logic; .github/scripts/commit_message_squash.py plus commit-message.yml/maintainer-approval.yml/review-module.yml rewire squash preview publication to the review gate. These are workflow-policy and reviewer-routing changes, with docs/skill/catalog edits supporting that same workflow scope rather than independent runtime modules.
